name: Chewy Chocolate Chip Cookies
ingredients:
7.9oz unsalted butter, cubed5.3oz caster sugar
5.3oz light brown sugar
3 large egg yolks
30ml whole milk
9.5oz plain flour
1 1/2 tsp baking powder
3/4 tsp bicarbonate soda
3 tbsp cornstarch
5.3oz dark chocolate, chopped
5.3oz milk chocolate, chopped
instructions:
1Cube the butter: Cube 8 ounces unsalted butter, cubed into small, evenly sized pieces so it melts evenly when browning.
2
Brown the butter: Melt the cubed butter in a saucepan over medium heat, stirring frequently, until golden brown with a nutty aroma. Be careful not to burn it.
3
Cool slightly: Let the browned butter cool slightly before using it in the dough.
4
Cream butter and sugars: In a large mixing bowl, cream together the browned butter, 5.4 ounces caster sugar, and 5.4 ounces light brown sugar.
5
Add egg yolks and milk: Add 3 large egg yolks and 0.1 cups whole milk to the butter mixture and mix until well combined.
6
Sift dry ingredients: In a separate bowl, sift together 9.6 ounces plain flour, 1.5 teaspoons baking powder, 0.8 teaspoons bicarbonate of soda, and 3 tablespoons cornstarch to remove lumps and evenly distribute the leaveners.
7
Combine wet and dry: Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet mixture, stirring until a smooth dough forms.
8
Fold in chocolate: Gently fold in 5.4 ounces dark chocolate, chopped and 5.4 ounces milk chocolate, chopped. Using chopped chocolate rather than chips helps it melt evenly through the cookies.
9
Chill the dough: Wrap the dough or transfer to an airtight container and refrigerate for at least 1440 minutes 
1440:00
 (up to 48 hours) to develop flavor and help the cookies hold their shape.
10
Preheat oven: Preheat your oven to 180°C (350°F).
11
Prepare baking sheet: Line a light-coloured baking sheet with parchment paper, large enough to leave space between cookies (about 3 cookies per 30cm sheet).
12
Portion the dough: Scoop the chilled dough into balls and place on the prepared sheet, leaving enough space between each for spreading. Optionally press extra chopped chocolate on top for a bakery-style look.
13
Bake: Bake for 11 minutes 
11:00
, or until golden brown around the edges. The centre may look underdone but will set as it cools.
14
Cool: Let the cookies cool on the baking sheet for at least 6 minutes 
06:00
 before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely.
notes: Chilling the dough is the key step — it firms the butter, lets flavor develop, and hydrates the flour for a smoother, chewier bake. Use light-coloured baking sheets so the bottoms don't overcook before the centres are done. Raw dough balls can be frozen and baked straight from frozen (just add a couple of minutes).
